# Recipe: permit2 @1 :: gasless-approval
# Schema: web3-context-mcp/05-DATA-MODEL.md §2.1  ·  Worklist item #17
#
# ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
# │ STATUS: ✅ VALIDATED 2026-08-11 by farseen (github: FarseenSh) — 13 quotes · 8         │
# │ structural · 9 fork assertions against deployed bytecode, all green.                  │
# │ (Banner and stamp changed in the SAME edit — see aave-v3, where this drifted twice.)   │
# └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
#
# ⚠ THREE CHAINS VERIFIED, ONE CHAIN EXERCISED — and `chains` says so.
#   P1 reads the DEPLOYMENT on ethereum, base and arbitrum: code length, code hash and
#   DOMAIN_SEPARATOR. `vm.createSelectFork` for base and arbitrum appears in P1 AND NOWHERE ELSE
#   — the entire signed-transfer flow (P2–P8) runs on the Ethereum mainnet fork. So `chains` is
#   [ethereum], not the three the `deployments` map lists. The aave-v3 pattern.
#   ⚠ An earlier draft of test/permit2/RUN.md told the curator to write all three, on the
#   grounds that "P1 exercises all three chains". It does not, and the instruction was corrected
#   before the stamp rather than after it.
#   📌 QUEUED AMENDMENT (owner, 2026-08-11): parameterise P2–P8 over the three forks so the flow
#   really does run on each, then widen `chains` by dated amendment. Worth doing; not blocking.
#
# ⚠ THE NAME OVERSELLS THE FIRST STEP. "gasless-approval" is the worklist's recipe_type, and
#   before any of it works the owner must send a REAL, GAS-PAYING `approve(PERMIT2, …)` on the
#   token — once per token per owner. Permit2 pulls funds with the TOKEN's own transferFrom.
#   What is gasless is every SUBSEQUENT authorisation: after that one approve, each spend is
#   authorised by an off-chain signature carrying its own amount, deadline and nonce.
#
# ⚠ AND THE SIGNED MESSAGE HAS A FIELD THE STRUCT DOES NOT. `PermitTransferFrom` is
#   {permitted, nonce, deadline} — no spender. The EIP-712 type that actually gets signed
#   includes `address spender`, and Permit2 fills it from `msg.sender`: the CONTRACT THAT CALLS
#   permitTransferFrom. Nothing in the struct or the function signature says so. See mistake #1.
#
# ⚠ ONE ADDRESS, THREE DIFFERENT BYTECODES. Permit2 is at the same deterministic address on
#   every chain, and its runtime code is NOT identical — same 9,152-byte length, three different
#   hashes, three different DOMAIN_SEPARATORs. A signature is scoped to one chain by
#   construction. Measured 2026-08-11; the mechanism is attested, not inferred (D1/D2).
#
# Sources pinned 2026-08-11 (repo-sourced — SCHEMA-DEPARTURES §6):
#   Uniswap/permit2 @ cc56ad0f3439c502c246fc5cfcc3db92bb8b7219

project_id: "permit2"       # the PUBLISHER name — never carries the major
version_major: 1            # ⚠ SEE SCHEMA-DEPARTURES §7. Permit2 publishes no semver at all:
                            #   it is one immutable deployment at a deterministic address, with
                            #   no version in the contract, the repo or any manifest. `1` here
                            #   means "the only deployment that has ever existed", NOT "major 1
                            #   of a series". Stated because the axis already carries two
                            #   meanings on `dynamic`, and this is a third.
version: "cc56ad0f"         # ⚠ NOT a semver. The pinned commit's short SHA, because that is the
                            #   only version identity this project has. See version_discriminator.
type: "gasless-approval"

# these two fields.

# ⭐ THE NUMBER WORTH CARRYING: `InvalidNonce()` = 0x756688fe, read off the deployed contract's
#   revert data rather than computed from a string. That is mistake #4's whole point — two
#   opposite nonce disciplines share one selector, so the revert cannot tell you which rule you
#   broke, and the measurement comes from the chain rather than from reading two source files.
#
# ⚠ P7's reported 1,057,463,769 gas is NOT a cost. It is the staticcall probe against WETH for
#   `nonces(address)` — a function that does not exist there — which is the assertion's point.
#   Recorded so nobody later quotes it as a permit2 gas figure.
last_validated: "2026-08-11"

# The chain the integration flow was actually exercised on. ⚠ NOT the three in `deployments` —

chains: [ethereum]

# ── PROVENANCE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
provenance:
  kind: "repo-sourced"
  repo: "Uniswap/permit2 @ cc56ad0f3439c502c246fc5cfcc3db92bb8b7219"
  note: "Stated explicitly because #3 privy and #5 dynamic are artifact-sourced and the kinds now
         sit side by side — SCHEMA-DEPARTURES §6. ⚠ The repo is DORMANT, not archived: last push
         2024-08-19, pinned commit 2023-09-29. For a deployed immutable contract dormancy is not
         staleness — the bytecode at the deterministic address has not changed either, and the
         recipe's fork test re-checks that rather than trusting it."

# ── THE DEPLOYMENT ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# One address on every chain. ⚠ The BYTECODE is not one bytecode — see mistake #3.
deployments:
  ethereum: "0x000000000022D473030F116dDEE9F6B43aC78BA3"
  base: "0x000000000022D473030F116dDEE9F6B43aC78BA3"
  arbitrum: "0x000000000022D473030F116dDEE9F6B43aC78BA3"

# ── APPROVAL FLOW ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# The field earns its place here more than in any other recipe in this repo: the whole point of
# Permit2 is the approval flow, and the first step is the one the name hides.
approval_flow:
  - "ONCE per (owner, token): the OWNER sends a real on-chain `approve(PERMIT2, amount)` to the
     TOKEN, paying gas. Most integrations approve type(uint256).max so it never recurs. ⚠ THIS
     STEP IS NOT GASLESS AND NOT SKIPPABLE — Permit2 moves funds via the token's transferFrom."
  - "PER SPEND: the owner signs an EIP-712 `PermitTransferFrom` off-chain — token, amount, an
     unused nonce, a deadline — with `spender` set to THE CONTRACT THAT WILL CALL PERMIT2."
  - "The spender contract calls `permitTransferFrom(permit, transferDetails, owner, signature)`
     and pays the gas. Permit2 verifies the signature, consumes the nonce bit, and calls the
     token's transferFrom."
